title: Taking Part in a Hearing: Unemployment Insurance Appeals Party Terms
content:
**To the parties of an appeal under Unemployment Insurance Appeals.** A party to a telephone hearing registers the phone number at which it will be called a set number of business days before the hearing. At the start time the hearing officer calls, and waits a set number of minutes for a party to answer before going on without that party. A party may be represented, an interpreter is provided at no cost on request, and on some dockets the claimant is given a referral to free legal aid.

## Terms by docket

| Docket | Register call-back number by (business days before the hearing) | Hearing officer waits for an answer (minutes) | Referral of the claimant to free legal aid |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lower Authority Appeal — Separation Issue | 1 | 15 | yes |
| Lower Authority Appeal — Able and Available Issue | 1 | 15 | yes |
| Lower Authority Appeal — Monetary Determination | 1 | 15 | yes |
| Lower Authority Appeal — Overpayment and Fraud | 1 | 15 | yes |
| Lower Authority Appeal — Employer Benefit Charge | 1 | 15 | no |
| Lower Authority Appeal — Employer Contribution Rate | 1 | 15 | no |
| Higher Authority Appeal — Board of Review | 0 (no hearing is held) | 0 (no hearing is held) | yes |

## Terms common to every docket

| Term | All seven dockets |
|---|---|
| Who may represent a party | an attorney or an authorized agent |
| Interpreter provided at no cost on request | yes |

## Illustrations

- On every lower-authority docket, a party registers its number no later than 1 business day before the hearing, and the hearing officer waits 15 minutes after the scheduled start for that party to answer.
- The referral to free legal aid is given on the four claimant-facing lower-authority dockets and on the Board of Review, and not on the Employer Benefit Charge or Employer Contribution Rate dockets.
